Service

Custom SEO Automation & Internal Tools

Turn repetitive SEO bottlenecks into reliable automated workflows, Python scripts, Google Search Console anomaly detectors, and custom data pipelines.

Signs

Signs this is what is holding you back

Reporting takes days every month

Data is copied by hand from Search Console, analytics and spreadsheets.

Drops are noticed late

Nobody is alerted when clicks, indexing or rankings move sharply.

The same checks are repeated

Briefs, schema checks or content QA follow a fixed routine that could run automatically.

Off-the-shelf tools do not fit

Your workflow needs a specific combination of data that no single tool provides.

What this service covers

  • n8n automated workflow pipelines
  • Python & Google Colab analysis scripts
  • Search Console API anomaly detection
  • Google Apps Script automation on Sheets
  • spaCy & sentence-transformers NLP pipelines
  • Custom WordPress plugins & browser extensions
  • Automated Looker Studio KPI reporting

What lands on your desk

  • Workflow map with the automation plan
  • Working automations (n8n flows, scripts or Apps Script projects)
  • Search Console anomaly alerts to Slack or email
  • Automated reporting to Sheets or Looker Studio
  • Documentation and a handover session
Method

Map, automate the boring part, keep a human check

The same sequence every time, so each step can be checked.

1

Map the current workflow and time spent on each manual step.

2

Pick the steps where automation saves the most time with the least risk.

3

Build with n8n, Python, Apps Script or Colab, using official APIs where they exist.

4

Keep a human review point wherever the output changes a live site or a client report.

5

Document the workflow so your team can run and adjust it.

Which tools do you build with?

n8n, Python, Google Apps Script, Google Colab and the Search Console, Analytics and other APIs, chosen to fit what your team already uses.

Who owns the automations?

You do. They run in your accounts, and the code and documentation are handed over.

Can AI be part of the workflow?

Yes, for tasks like clustering, extraction and first-draft briefs, always with a review step before anything is published.
